literal_meaning: রাতার রাতি (night after night or overnight)
figurative_meaning_en: in a very short time or overnight
similar_in_english: at the drop of a hat
in the blink of an eye
example_sentences_in_english: It's not possible to become rich overnight.
note: The idiom emphasizes the improbability of sudden transformations, rooted in realistic expectations of gradual progress.
